desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/dinov2
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov2.git

## File: facebookresearch_dinov2/dinov2/hub/cell_dino/backbones.py

Prompts

```
['build a Cell-DINO ViT-L/16 model pretrained on the HPA dataset with 4 input channels', 'build a Cell-DINO ViT-L/14 model pretrained on LVD then fine-tuned on the HPA dataset', 'build a Cell-DINO ViT-S/8 model pretrained on the combined cell painting dataset with 5 input channels', 'build a channel-adaptive Cell-DINO ViT-L/16 model for single-channel microscopy images', 'build a custom Cell-DINO vision transformer model with configurable architecture, patch size, and pretrained weights']
```

Usage

```
{'build_cell_dino_hpa_vitl16': 'build a Cell-DINO ViT-L/16 model pretrained on the HPA dataset with 4 input channels', 'build_cell_dino_hpa_vitl14': 'build a Cell-DINO ViT-L/14 model pretrained on LVD then fine-tuned on the HPA dataset', 'build_cell_dino_cp_vits8': 'build a Cell-DINO ViT-S/8 model pretrained on the combined cell painting dataset with 5 input channels', 'build_channel_adaptive_dino_vitl16': 'build a channel-adaptive Cell-DINO ViT-L/16 model for single-channel microscopy images', 'build_make_cell_dino_model': 'build a custom Cell-DINO vision transformer model with configurable architecture, patch size, and pretrained weights'}
```
